_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Agkalabas mo so Klondike Solitaire. Say goal mo et ya mirapit iray amin ya kartas ed foundation piles.

Panaglayag ya Laro:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Tukoen so Ace ya anggad King diad suit
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Tukoen so baba ya nanengneng ya kulor (kolorado ed itom, itom ed kolorado)
- Stock: Gaween so kartas ed waste pile
- Waste (W): Top card ya available para play

Commands:
- 'draw' - Gaween so kartas manlapud stock ya waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Iyakar so kartas diad pila
  Examples: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count et niyan nen 'all', ya ag-try ya iyakar amin ya face-up cards.
- 'forfeit' - Taposen so laro ya kaagad ya ila-lock so skor mo
- Pile names: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Nengneng mo ya iyakar amin ya aksyon diad sakey turn ya pagpirpir so komma:
  Example: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kings labat so nayari ed empty tableau piles.
Aksyon et man-execute diad orden - no nayari so sakey, say natatandaan aksyon et iskip.
Usaren 'forfeit' no panisipen mo ya imposible ya agka-panalo so laro.

format_error.no_brackets: Aliwan dugan format na action. Say action et nepeg ya walad parentesis.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Aliwan dugan format na action. Anggapoy closing bracket ']'
format_error.move_needs_args: Say move a komando so mankaukolan na source tan destination. Usage: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Count et nengneng ya positive o 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Invalid count. Usaren ya numero o 'all'

action_result.before_failure: Saray agawaan {n} ya ginawa antis na impaka-fail.

move_result.drew: Inekal toy card (s) to manlapud stock anggad basura.
move_result.cannot_draw: Agnayarin man-draw. Anggapoy karga tan basura ed saray suplay na ayayep.
move_result.invalid_pile: Agka-invalido so ngaran na pila. Usaren yo so W, F1-F4, o T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Nayari labat ya iyalis so 1 a kard ed pundasyon.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Inalis so kard manlapud basura ed pundasyon F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Agnayarin iyalis so karga na basura ed satan ya pundasyon a pila
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Inilipat so karta manlapud tableau T{src} ed foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Agnayarin iyalis so table card ed satan ya pundasyon na pila
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Agnayarin onalis manlapud sakey a pundasyon paonlad sananey ya pundasion.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Nayari labat ya iyalis so 1 a kard manlapud basura ed tabla.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Inalis so kard manlapud basura ed tabla T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Agka-maliket so ibalen so karta na waste ed sayan pila na tableau
move_result.no_face_up: Anggapoy aka-open a kard ya iyalis.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Inilipat so {count} karta(s) manlapud tableau T{src} ed T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Dapat a ilipat so {count} karta(s) manlapud T{src} ed T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Nayari labat ya iyalis so 1 a kard manlapud base anggad tableau.
move_result.foundation_empty: Say Foundation F{src} et anggapoy karga to.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Inilipat so karta manlapud foundation F{src} ed tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Agka-maliket so ibalen so karta na foundation ed tableau T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Agnayarin iyalis ed basura odino itiponan.

outcome.forfeit: Naibitin so palaro. Katapusang iskor: {score} karta ed foundation.
outcome.won: Komendasyon, analo kayo ed Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Napagpa si game! Nakala so maksimum na {max_turns} turno. Puntos: {score} karta ed foundation.
